meta.title: Ossus asset plan
meta.author: Fable (helper run), research only
meta.scope: What a first playable Ossus needs, and where each piece can come from: stock SWG art already in the owner's client, MTG archives, open-licensed sources, cheap paid sources. Nothing was downloaded, bought or installed; no accounts, no contact.
meta.stock_basis: Stock assets are referenced in place inside the owner's own client archives (the same basis as the Hoth port); they are never copied out or redistributed. 125,572 stock files were indexed through the client's real load order with our own TRE reader (Fable-planet-test/tools/trn_iff.py).
meta.disc_archives: /opt/swg/disc-extracted/SWG-group/files/SWG/: 149 files; the same archives as the installed client through patch_17 plus patch_18..33 and the sku1/sku2/sku3 (expansion) archives. patch_18+ and the later sku archives are TRE version 6 with an all-zero header; our reader and Core3's version-6 branch (tre3/TreeFile.cpp:80 reads no header fields) cannot locate their index. Trials of Obi-Wan (sku3) art such as the Mustafar Jedi temple ruins therefore remains unreadable from the disc; MTG carries the same SOE files.
meta.mtg_credit: Catalogue status P for the MTG planets family: credit Mod the Galaxy and the original contributors, preserve file notices (Community-content/CREDITS-and-sources.txt). Original SOE assets inside MTG belong to their rights holders, as for stock art.

conversion_tools_today.iff: Our own IFF reader/writer (tools/trn_iff.py) handles any IFF file: cloning a stock .sht with a new texture name, cloning a .snd template, writing .apt redirects, writing .trn.
conversion_tools_today.datatables_strings: Claude's swg_client_data.py reads datatables and .stf; Bellum's AGPL packers were used for local_planets.tre (to be replaced by our own).
conversion_tools_today.meshes: NoStyleGuy io_scene_swg_msh (MIT, Blender 2.9+/3.x): imports/exports MSH, MGN, LOD, POB, SKT and generates .apt/.sat/.lmg; no animation support, SKT export unreliable, collision extents stored but not editable, textures left to external tools. Not validated by us yet (feature register F86); the first external 3D prop is a validation task, not a content task.
conversion_tools_today.textures: DDS DXT1/DXT5 via NVIDIA Texture Tools or Microsoft texconv (installs need the owner's OK); our own writer could emit uncompressed DDS as a fallback.
conversion_tools_today.audio: SWG .snd is a 160-byte SD2D template naming a sample (e.g. sample/amb_forest_lp.wav); a new loop needs a WAV (stock loops are mono) plus a cloned .snd.
conversion_tools_today.creatures: No path for new rigged, animated creatures (MGN+SKT+ANS) today; new creatures use stock bodies with our names and stats, which the owner's encounter policy allows.

fab_standard.clauses: Summary: 'Use the assets commercially or privately', 'Modify and adjust the assets', 'Use the assets with any compatible tools (usage is not limited to Unreal Engine)', 'Share the asset ... with your collaborators'; 'You may not: Resell or redistribute the asset for free on a standalone basis'. Full text: 'you may Distribute a Project that incorporates Content as an included dependency to end users ... only authorize end users to make use of Content solely as incorporated in the Project in object code and you must restrict end users from extracting or otherwise ...'; 'you may not make Content available in world- or level-editing tools or templates or other modeling tools that allow works to be exported'; no credit required; CC-BY tier governed by CC.
fab_standard.client_archive_redistribution: no: SWG TRE archives are openly extractable with public tools, so the 'restrict end users from extracting' duty cannot be met in substance

unity_asset_store.clauses: EULA 2.2.1: incorporate into a product with substantial original content; reproduce/display/distribute the Asset 'as incorporated and embedded in that Licensed Product'; 2.2.1(e) may modify; 2.2.1.1(b) may not 'sell, transfer, distribute, lease, or lend the Assets for commercial gain'; no attribution clause; Restricted Assets may carry their own terms; use outside Unity is not addressed ('intended purpose').
unity_asset_store.client_archive_redistribution: grey: no extractability clause, but 'embedded' and 'intended purpose' are open to argument; prefer not

cgtrader_royalty_free.clauses: 21A.2 games only where the Product 'is contained inside a proprietary format and displays inside the game during play'; 21A.3 'all commercially reasonable measures to prevent the end user from gaining access to the Product'; definition 8: Incorporated Product 'cannot be extracted ... without the use of reverse engineering tools'; 21A.6 no resale or redistribution unless incorporated; no attribution.
cgtrader_royalty_free.client_archive_redistribution: no: TRE archives are not a protective format

sketchfab_store.url: https://sketchfab.com/licenses (legacy store purchases; the store itself moved to Fab)
sketchfab_store.clauses: 2.2(b): may not 'sell, license, distribute or otherwise make available the Licensed Material as a stand-alone file (or group of files) or in a way that allows third parties to use, download, extract or access the Licensed Material'; 2.7 licensee must post terms forbidding reuse as a stand-alone file; Editorial licence excludes commercial use.

artstation_marketplace.clauses: Standard: 'you may copy, use, modify, adapt, translate, distribute, publicly display, transmit, broadcast, and create derivative works from the Product in works you create ... which may include ... computer games'; restrictions include (c) 'hack, reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, modify or create derivative works of the Product' outside Works and (h) removing proprietary notices. The stand-alone-distribution clause was not captured in this pass; check per product.
artstation_marketplace.client_archive_redistribution: check per product; expect a no-stand-alone clause

itch_io.clauses: itch.io sets no common asset licence; each page states its own (CC0, CC-BY or custom). Arludus: no redistribution of files even modified. KayKit: CC0.

cc0.clauses: no conditions; copying, alteration and redistribution, including inside client archives, are allowed; attribution voluntary

cc_by.clauses: credit the author, link the licence, indicate changes; no further restriction

cc_by_sa.clauses: as CC-BY plus share-alike on the adapted file; flag before use (C15 catalogue note)
cc_by_sa.client_archive_redistribution: only with the adapted file under the same licence

cc_nc.clauses: non-commercial variants excluded from this plan (catalogue rule)
